title: Abstracting Byte Streams
goal: Read from and write to any byte source or destination using Read and Write.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

sections.text: You interact with files, sockets, and in-memory buffers through the `Read` and `Write` traits. They behave like stream interfaces in other languages.

sections.caption: R accepts any type that implements Read.

sections.text: The `Write` trait works the same way for outputs. Byte vectors and slices implement these traits directly.

sections.caption: Pass a mutable reference to write into a buffer.

sections.text: Because `Write` methods take a mutable reference, passing `&mut Vec<u8>` allows writing repeatedly without losing ownership of the buffer.

explanation: Read from and write to any byte source or destination using Read and Write.
